change_summary: Increase SQS consumer concurrency from 5 to 20 workers for notification-service to reduce message processing backlog.
diff_or_config:
--- a/config/worker.yaml
+++ b/config/worker.yaml
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 worker:
   queue: notifications-prod
-  concurrency: 5
+  concurrency: 20
   visibility_timeout: 300
   max_retries: 3
   batch_size: 10
service_context: notification-worker processes ~50k messages/day from SQS. Sends emails, push notifications, SMS via downstream providers. Current avg processing time: 200ms/msg.
rollback_plan: Set concurrency back to 5 if issues arise.

seeded_gaps.description: No staged rollout - all workers restart at once with 4x concurrency
Rollback plan is vague - no trigger condition specified
No alerting for downstream rate limits, worker errors, or resource exhaustion
No SLO or customer impact assessment for 4x throughput increase
No load test or staging validation for 20-worker concurrency
